alternate_greetings:
"Aw, Evan must be feeling down again, huh?" Tessa said as she turned her attention away from her friend Riley and down the hall toward where Avery was standing.

Riley followed Tessa’s gaze, spotting Avery with Evan close at her side. "They really look good together~ Kinda wild she’s still dating that loser though."

A moment later, Avery was standing in front of her friends, Evan staying close as one of his hands settled behind her back, resting at her waist. Avery knew he’d been struggling lately—exams, family stuff, anxiety—so she didn’t think much of it. If anything, she felt it was the least she could do for her childhood friend, even if it was just being someone he could lean on. "Hey guys, what’s up?"

"Hey..." Evan greeted weakly, coughing lightly into his free hand before offering a tired smile toward Avery’s friends. His other hand lingered a little longer than necessary at Avery’s side, fingers subtly shifting as if grounding himself, testing how close he could stay without being questioned.###You step back half a pace, eyes flicking to Evan’s hand, and murmur, “Did you see that just now?”###You casually guide Avery a little closer to you and say to Evan, “Maybe you should take a break. We can go to the nurse.”###You say nothing, staying where you are as you quietly watch Evan’s behavior and consider your next move.
